review.summary: Read-only review passed within the admitted contract. Inspected all assigned source/tests and supporting artifacts; verified pinned upstream hashes, exact mechanical helper adaptation, license equality, and all 10 manifest entries. No security or logic defect found. The 3/4-bit packing offsets, aligned uint32 staging for uint16 views, signed-index bounds, affine-group indexing, fast K%512 dispatch, slow safe final step, inactive-tail-lane guards, and two 32-lane SIMD groups covering eight output rows are consistent. Admitted one/two-pack counts keep the retained 3-bit helper pointer progression in bounds. Original HALF input-sum expressions, float accumulators, SIMD reductions, and final dtype casts are preserved at source level. Boolean/dtype validation and lazy runtime loading satisfy the documented admission boundary. Independently reran 312 pytest tests and 2 unittest tests; Ruff check and format check passed. Pytest import guarding confirmed no MLX, NumPy, or model runtime loaded. Evidence contains 18 ordered recorded RED/GREEN pairs, but historical execution timing was not independently reconstructed. No files were created or modified; sibling attention files were untouched. Metal compilation, numerical behavior, and performance remain unproven, not CPU-certified.

scope: Independent CPU/source review only. Parent GPU evidence remains separate; noncontiguous GPU materialization, distributed32B admission and acceleration timing are not certified by this review.
